$schema_note: Declarative spec of the companion overlay UI as built (APK sha256 938d3232...). Values are the real ones from CompanionShell.kt / CompanionOverlayService.kt. Update together with code.

position.y: character's current Y (pinned to her top edge)

expanded_band.touch_passthrough: above and below the band; unconsumed touches in-band also fall through
expanded_band.note: deliberately never full-screen - overlay pixels cannot pass touches, so a full-screen window would block the whole device

left_panel.content_source: activeTool, falls back to lastTool while sliding out
left_panel.switching: tapping a different icon swaps content in place; tapping the active icon closes it

state.activeTool: CompanionTool? - left panel visible when non-null
state.lastTool: CompanionTool? - keeps panel content during exit animation
state.expanded: mirror of shellOpen for legacy guards

interactions.effect: closeShell: activeTool=null, inputOpen=false, window relayouts to collapsed
passes through to the app behind (FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL)

theme.effect: translucent card + blur (API 31+); translucent tint carries the look below API 31
theme.design_intent: character always visible behind panels; nothing fully occludes her
